Perched above the flowing creek and surrounded by the timeless beauty of the canyon, the home feels inseparable from its natural settingan enduring sanctuary shaped by stone, water, and more than a century of history. More than a residence, this is a living piece of Malibu's past and an exceptionally rare opportunity to preserve and inhabit its story. results.remarks: At 6734 Zumirez, the most valuable investment has already been made: time. Nearly a decade in the making, the vision for this new residence has advanced through architecture, engineering, environmental studies, California Coastal Commission approvals (CDP Permit No. 20-068), city planning, and countless refinements - transforming years of complexity, uncertainty, and investment into a singular opportunity. The project is in the final approval stage with the City of Malibu building department and construction is tentatively scheduled to begin in the fall. While that work quietly unfolded, the property remained exactly what Point Dume has always been: an authentic coastal retreat that you can enjoy from day one. Before the building begins and the architecture evolves, the property is already a place to live, gather, and experience everything that has made Point Dume one of Malibu's most treasured enclaves. The beautifully restored 1949 cottage offers two bedrooms, one bath, and expansive ocean views from nearly every room. Filled with natural light and opening to generous decks overlooking the Pacific, it captures the quiet simplicity that first defined coastal Malibu. The existing home is warm, inviting, and effortlessly livable - a place to spend weekends by the beach, gather family and friends, and embrace the slower rhythm that has defined this stretch of coastline for generations. Enjoy it exactly as it exists today or begin creating the future estate when the time is right. The difficult part...the years spent navigating approvals, revisions, and entitlements has already been accomplished. The architecture can be built. The investment can be made. But the years required to arrive here cannot be bought. The CDP approved new residence consists of approximately 7,303 square feet, an additional 986 square foot basement, 5 bedrooms, 5.5 bathrooms, 50 foot oceanside pool and jacuzzi, movie theatre, spa facilities with massage room, cold plunge, dry sauna and steam shower; a separate guest retreat with an additional bedroom and bathroom, private jacuzzi and tranquil garden space. Warm and natural materials are planned for the construction with every wall, every proportion, every transition, and every framed view thoughtfully refined. Nothing was incidental. Every decision served a singular purpose: to create a residence whose architecture feels as relevant decades from now as it does today. Every decision was ultimately guided by one simple belief: Architecture should not compete with nature. It should reveal it. While many Malibu homes are designed to admire the ocean from afar, the new residence is designed to live with it, where the coastline becomes an extension of home. A private pathway leads directly from the property to the sand, allowing you to leave home and arrive at the beach in moments...this way of living becomes a natural extension of your everyday routine. Included with the property is also ownership in the highly coveted Malibu Riviera One, a private beachfront parcel owned collectively by Zumirez homeowners. Beyond its privacy and exclusivity, it transforms a day at the beach into an effortless experience, being the only gate in Point Dume with drive-up access, parking just steps from the sand. The true luxury isn't simply private ownership, it's removing the effort between home and the ocean. Together, the private pathway directly from the home itself and ownership of Malibu Riviera One create an experience found on only a select handful of Point Dume properties.

Double doors from the dining room open to a screened-in porch where panoramic 180-degree ocean views stretch from the Queen's Necklace and Catalina Island up the coastline toward Santa Barbara, creating the perfect backdrop for morning coffee, sunset entertaining, or peaceful evenings surrounded by nature. The main home offers two comfortable bedrooms, while three detached bungalows provide exceptional flexibility for guests, extended family, creative studios, home offices, or income-producing rentals. The expansive grounds have been thoughtfully enhanced with new fencing and grading, creating multiple usable flat pads ready for your vision. Imagine a pool and spa, pickleball or sport court, outdoor kitchen, gym, cold plunge, gardens, or additional entertaining areas. The possibilities are virtually limitless. Completing the ranch lifestyle are a detached garage, ample guest parking, a charming chicken coop, future vegetable gardens, mature fruit trees, and majestic century-old Italian stone pines that provide beauty, shade, and remarkable privacy. Miles of nearby hiking trails wind through breathtaking canyons with ocean vistas and peaceful creek beds just beyond your backyard. Offering sweeping ocean views, usable acreage, incredible versatility, and an authentic connection to Malibu's rich ranching heritage, this is far more than a home it's a private sanctuary where history, nature, and opportunity come together. Properties with this level of character, land, privacy, and potential rarely become available.

results.remarks: Tucked into the serene hills of Corral Canyon, 26207 Ingleside Way offers tranquil Malibu living in one of the area's most idyllic enclaves. Embracing its striking canyon surroundings, the home features sweeping views, abundant natural light through expansive windows, and a dramatic central skylight. An open floor plan creates seamless flow between the living, dining, and kitchen areas, while the bedrooms, including one with its own private entrance, enjoy picturesque outlooks and a calming ambiance. The primary suite serves as a peaceful retreat framed by treetop vistas, complete with a spacious bathroom featuring an oversized jetted soaking tub, step-in shower, and generous walk-in closet. A versatile level below includes a bonus bathroom, private entrance, and space for a creative studio, home office, or potential ADU conversion. Outdoor decks and natural landscaping further enhance the home's connection to its setting, creating an effortless indoor-outdoor lifestyle. Beyond the home lies what locals affectionately call the Malibu Bowl, a natural valley floor at the heart of Corral Canyon, surrounded by rolling hills and open skies. As the only canyon in Malibu that isn't a through street, and the only undeveloped coastal canyon in all of LA, the area enjoys minimal traffic and a peaceful, bucolic "old Malibu" charm, while remaining close to the beaches, shops, restaurants, and schools of central Malibu. *Seller willing to consider a credit toward a temporary mortgage rate buydown (subject to lender approval) which may help qualified buyers reduce their monthly payment!

results.remarks:
11914 Beach Club Way presents an exceptionally rare opportunity to acquire a true beachfront property in one of Malibu’s most exclusive and supply-constrained coastal communities. Located directly on the sand along the highly coveted Malibu Road coastline, the property offers unobstructed panoramic ocean views, immediate beach access, and a level of privacy rarely available on the market. This is the only triplex within the community and one of the largest and widest units in the complex, totaling approximately 2,680 square feet. Originally constructed as a single-family residence and grandfathered by the HOA as a legal 3-unit property, the asset will be delivered fully vacant at the close of escrow, creating a rare opportunity for an owner-user, multigenerational family compound, luxury rental investment, or private coastal retreat. Ideally positioned adjacent to the beach access stairs, the property offers an exceptional combination of flexibility, lifestyle appeal, and income potential.

Also, the units can easily be reconfigured back into a single expansive beachfront residence, creating a level of optionality rarely found in Malibu oceanfront real estate. 1914 Beach Club Way includes two dedicated parking spaces, an exceptionally valuable amenity in an area where parking is extremely limited. The spaces are located in the covered carports, while the additional two spaces were separately acquired by ownership, available for purchase at an additional cost.

The community has recently undergone and is continuing to undergo meaningful improvements, including refreshed community-wide landscaping, common area improvements, cleanup and correction of the sandbox area, a newly rebuilt retaining wall, a community pool, and two paddleball courts. The HOA has also announced a significant rebuilding of the pool/spa area, including new plumbing, electrical, and operating equipment, further enhancing the long-term quality and appeal of the community. Surrounded by some of the most prestigious oceanfront homes in Southern California, the property benefits from Malibu’s enduring global appeal, low-density coastal character, and strong long-term demand fundamentals. The location offers convenient access to Pacific Coast Highway while remaining moments from Malibu’s premier dining, shopping, and recreational destinations, as well as easy connectivity to Santa Monica and the greater Westside.

results.remarks: Welcome to coastal living in this beautifully upgraded Malibu townhome with ocean views, located in the exclusive gated Toscana community, just minutes from Pepperdine and the beach. Ideal for those seeking space, privacy, and high-end amenities. The first floor offers a secure 2-car garage with epoxy flooring, overhead storage racks, custom built-in cabinetry, storage closets, and a whole-home Halo water filtration system. The main living level is designed for both everyday living and entertaining, showcasing soaring ceilings, hardwood floors, abundant natural light, and an open floor plan. The formal living room features an elegant gas fireplace and balcony, while the dining room flows seamlessly into the chef's kitchen with Viking appliances, center island, breakfast bar, pantry, and generous prep space. A versatile bonus room with closets and a king-size Murphy bed can easily function as a third bedroom, guest suite, office, gym, or creative studio. It opens directly to a private, fully fenced backyard featuring newly refreshed landscaping, a grassy lawn, mature greenery, and a built-in gas line ready for a grill or fire pit. A stylish guest bathroom and statement chandelier complete the main level. Upstairs, the primary suite captures sweeping ocean views from every window - including the bedroom, bathroom, shower, and soaking tub. Highlights include a private balcony, cozy gas fireplace, and oversized walk-in closet with custom built-ins, and a spacious spa-inspired bathroom finished in timeless travertine stone. The second bedroom enjoys its own private bathroom and balcony with mountain views. An upstairs office/sitting room with skylight and an oversized laundry room with sink and abundant storage provide additional functionality. Dual-zone A/C and heating systems allow for independent climate control on each floor, ensuring personalized comfort year-round. Smart Nest thermostats provide remote temperature control, and the home is pre-wired for ADT security for added peace of mind. Residents of the highly sought-after 22-unit gated community of Toscana enjoy access to a clubhouse, fitness center, heated pool and spa, beautifully landscaped grounds, security, and controlled entry. A pedestrian and bike path provides convenient access to Malibu Country Mart, Surf Canyon, Cross Creek, Bluffs Park, Malibu's world-famous beaches, and Pepperdine. With ocean views, flexible living spaces, private outdoor areas, and an unbeatable Malibu location, this home offers the perfect combination of luxury, comfort, and convenience.

results.remarks: Welcome to Portico, one of Malibu's most intimate and coveted gated enclaves, consisting of just 21 residences and offering a rare blend of Mediterranean elegance and relaxed coastal living. Behind a charming gated archway framed by soaring palms, this beautifully updated condominium is the largest in the community and showcases a seamless indoor-outdoor lifestyle. Thoughtfully designed with spacious interiors and abundant natural light, the main level features an open-concept layout enhanced by stone and wood floors, graceful architectural archways, and soaring ceilings. The living room, centered around a cozy fireplace, flows effortlessly to an oversized, lushly landscaped private patio perfect for entertaining or unwinding in total privacy. The dining area connects naturally to the outdoors, while the custom gourmet kitchen is a true showpiece, complete with top-of-the-line Miele appliances, custom cabinetry, and built-in storage. Upstairs, two expansive primary suites offer luxurious retreats, each with ensuite baths and generous closet space. The main suite features its own fireplace, a spa-inspired bathroom with a freestanding soaking tub, and a private covered balcony with scenic Point Dume views. The second suite also enjoys a private balcony, inviting in refreshing ocean breezes and natural light. Additional highlights include a main-level powder room, a finished two-car attached garage with built-ins, and multiple outdoor living spaces including a generous courtyard patio ideal for gatherings. Portico residents enjoy resort-style amenities including a heated saltwater pool, outdoor kitchen with BBQ, and a spacious dining pavilion. Ideally located just moments from Point Dume Village, the Nature Preserve, and some of Malibu's most pristine beaches including Westward Beach this home offers the perfect balance of privacy, sophistication, and coastal convenience.

results.remarks: Views of the entire coastline, Los Flores canyon and Santa Monica bay, with decks built to command them. Light-filled tri-level retreat with a grand deck off the kitchen to take in 270-degree panoramic views up the canyons and down into the Pacific. Hot tub included. Whitewater, coastline and city-light views filling nearly every window of the home. Set on 1.6 private acres high on coveted Castlewood Drive, the residence offers four bedrooms, three baths, generous living and dining spaces, and a versatile lower-level bonus room ideal for an office, studio, gym, or guests. The primary suite occupies the upper floor, opening to a private wraparound balcony where sunset and ocean views unfold in every direction. Owned solar with whole-home battery backup keeps the property running quietly and self-sufficiently. Modern mountain living, engineered for peace of mind. Outside, the land lives like few mountain parcels can: a broad, level bench below the house, garden paths linking the house, garage, and driveway, and a private lookout perched above the home. Plenty of flat, usable ground with room for a pool or terraced gardens. And rising below the residence: a new 36' x 40' (1,440 sq ft) steel structure with adjoining view deck and custom bi-fold hangar door (currently in plan-check) ready to finish as a collector's garage, artist's studio, workshop, or expansive live/work retreat. Minutes to Malibu's beaches and restaurants, an easy reach to Calabasas and the Westside, within the acclaimed Santa MonicaMalibu school district. A rare offering where the views, the land, and the lifestyle are already in place.

Designed for both intimate living and effortless entertaining, the home balances warmth and sophistication throughout. A separate ADU with private entrance and kitchenette presents an exceptional opportunity for guest accommodations, income potential, or multigenerational living adding a valuable layer of flexibility and investment appeal. A rare offering that combines space, character, and lifestyle this is Malibu canyon living at its most compelling.

results.remarks:
Perched above the scenic beauty of Solstice Canyon Park, this Malibu property offers unmatched privacy, breathtaking vistas, and a rare opportunity to own nearly 10 acres of prime coastal land. With only two nearby neighbors, the home enjoys a serene and secluded setting, where sweeping ocean and canyon views are visible from almost every room.

This updated 3 Br, 3 Bth residence spans 2,143 square feet and seamlessly blends luxury with comfort. A long driveway lined with elegant pavers leads to a welcoming courtyard framed by canyon views. Inside, soaring vaulted ceilings, abundant natural light, and refined finishes create an atmosphere of relaxed sophistication. French Oak flooring, custom built-ins, and recessed lighting elevate every space.

Designed with entertaining in mind, the home boasts a superb indoor-outdoor flow, opening onto expansive tiled wraparound decks with striking curved glass railings that frame the dramatic landscape beyond. The heart of the home is a chef’s dream kitchen, complete with a commercial-grade Wolf stove and pot filler, a stainless steel Wolf wall-mounted chimney hood, a Sub-Zero refrigerator, a central island, and a stylish tile backsplash stretching between custom cabinetry—ideal for everyday living and elevated entertaining.

The spacious primary suite is a true retreat, featuring a cozy gas fireplace, vaulted ceilings, and a spa-like ensuite bath, a glass-enclosed shower, and a luxurious soaking tub framed by windows that offer tranquil ocean views. A generous walk-in closet with custom built-ins enhances both function and elegance. Two additional bedrooms and meticulously designed guest bathrooms provide comfort and privacy for family or visitors. A dedicated home office enjoys panoramic views of the ocean and canyon, creating an inspiring workspace. 

The residence also includes two gas fireplaces, high-efficiency heating and cooling systems, Low-E windows, and paid-off solar panels that contribute to significant energy savings. A separate laundry room offers everyday convenience, while a detached two-car garage is complemented by a bonus guest suite or studio space above.

Re-Built in 2012, this home combines modern amenities with timeless design, all set within one of Malibu’s most sought-after and picturesque locations. 

Whether you're seeking a peaceful coastal haven or a stunning backdrop for entertaining, this extraordinary property delivers the very best of the Malibu lifestyle.

results.remarks: How fortunate to discover this beautiful three-bedroom, four-bathroom oceanfront retreat, offering an exceptional Malibu lifestyle at an incredible value. Located in the gated Malibu Bay Club, this special community provides direct beach access along with amenities including a pool and spa.  The main level is designed for relaxed coastal living, featuring an ocean-view kitchen, living, and dining area, a full bath, and a covered deck, perfect for morning coffee or gorgeous sunset evenings. The lowest level offers a spacious, self-contained studio with a kitchenette and 3/4 bath, ideal as a third bedroom, private office, or beach cabana. It opens directly to the patio with access to the beach below. Set along one of Malibu's most captivating stretches of coastline, this is a place to watch surfers and kite surfers glide by, spot dolphins and seals offshore, and enjoy the ever-changing beauty of the ocean - right outside your door.

results.remarks: MAJOR PRICE REDUCTION!! Seller wants it SOLD!! Experience coastal living at its finest in this beautifully updated beachfront residence in Malibu. Showcasing breathtaking ocean views from the main living areas, this home is designed to capture the essence of the Malibu lifestyle. The open-concept great room flows seamlessly onto an oversized oceanfront deck, complete with a trellis for shaded indoor-outdoor living, perfect for entertaining or simply enjoying the sound of the waves. The home has been enhanced with new flooring throughout, including the patio, creating a cohesive and refreshed coastal aesthetic. Three skylights fill the space with natural light. A newly added oversized island with countertop seating elevates both functionality and design. The home features three spacious bedrooms, each with its own en-suite bathroom, along with a powder room for guests. Recent improvements include new sliding glass closet doors in all bedrooms, brand-new recessed, wall, and pendant lighting throughout and a new water softening system for enhanced comfort and convenience. The updated kitchen and bathrooms offer both style and functionality, with radiant heated floors in the bathrooms for added luxury. Wake up and fall asleep to the soothing rhythm of the ocean, with direct beach access just steps from your door. The gated community offers two beautiful sandy beaches on either side, creating a sense of privacy and tranquility. Enjoy nearby County Line Beach, known for its excellent surf and windsurfing. Additional amenities include a private two-car carport, a paddle tennis court, and a sport court with a basketball hoop. Whether you're looking for a full-time residence or a weekend retreat, this is a rare opportunity to own a slice of Malibu!

results.remarks:
Experience the pinnacle of Malibu oceanfront living with this exceptional coastal retreat. Perfectly positioned at the eastern end of the complex and just one unit from the private beach access, this residence captures breathtaking whitewater coastline views and allows you to enjoy all Malibu has to offer. Wake to the sound of waves and step out to your beachfront deck to take in the sun, surf, the marine wildlife and all the activity on the beach. Then imagine enjoying your beverage of choice while taking in the most amazing sunsets you’ll ever see.  The main residence features 2 bedrooms and 2.5 bathrooms, thoughtfully designed with a seamless blend of sophistication and comfort. Interiors include porcelain plank flooring on the main level and luxury vinyl planks upstairs. The primary bedroom enjoys amazing ocean views and a built-in desk area.  The chef’s kitchen is outfitted with a Viking gas range and SubZero refrigerator, complimented by beautiful quartzite countertops. A detached 1-bedroom apartment with kitchen sits across a charming open-air courtyard, offering privacy and versatility for guests or creative use. The courtyard also includes a built in marine grade barbecue with storage cabinets and an outdoor shower.

Other highlights include fully paid solar power system with Tesla battery back-up and a Tesla car charger and a two car carport with additional storage and direct access to the home.

A gated setting within a sought-after community offering access to pristine beaches, a sport court with basketball, shuffleboard and pickleball and County line beach access on the west end of the community.

This is a rare opportunity to own a truly one-of-a-kind Malibu beachfront home—where luxury, privacy, and the ocean meet.

results.remarks: New Co-Ownership Opportunity: Own one-eighth of this professionally managed, turnkey coastal retreat.  Available for lease from September 17 through October 1 (two weeks) for $20,000. Should the tenant choose to purchase the property, 50% of the lease amount will be credited toward the purchase price.  This property engages every sense, from its striking modern architecture to the refined textures and finishes within, all complemented by the sound and scent of nearby ocean breezes. Just steps from the beach, the home offers ocean views, an infinity pool, and seamless indoor-outdoor living throughout.  The living room features a gas fireplace, beamed ceilings, and sliding glass pocket doors that open wide to frame the coastal views. The gourmet kitchen is equipped with high-end appliances, a generous island with breakfast bar, and direct access to a grilling deck. In the formal dining room, glass doors lead to an inviting outdoor setting complete with pool, spa, and fire pit.  The primary suite is a private sanctuary with its own fireplace, walk-in closet, and pocket doors opening to a tranquil garden. The spa-like en suite bath includes a dual-sink vanity and steam shower. Downstairs, enjoy a state-of-the-art home theater with projection screen, along with two guest suites, each with en suite baths, and a versatile office or flex space.  Offered fully furnished and professionally designed, this home delivers effortless luxury and turnkey ownership in an exceptional beachside setting.

results.remarks: Exceptional location, elevated amenities, and compelling value come together in this rare Malibu offering. This ocean-view architectural townhome is located within Zuma Bay Villas, a guard-gated Point Dume community offering 24-hour security and resort-style amenities.Originally selected as one of the community's model residences, this home enjoys a special place in the development's history, reflecting the thoughtful design and desirable features often showcased in a builder's premier offerings. Held and enjoyed by the same family for over 50 years, the residence has been lovingly maintained across generations.The current owners completed a comprehensive, thoughtfully planned, top-of-the-line renovation, updating the kitchen, bathrooms, living areas, windows, and Fleetwood breezeway doors while blending timeless architecture with modern comfort. The end-unit layout features open-concept living spaces filled with abundant natural light. Its exceptional positioning captures expansive ocean and whitewater views extending from Zuma Beach toward Leo Carrillo and the Channel Islands, along with incredible sunsets. Throughout, the home has a warm, inviting feeling that is equally suited for comfortable everyday living and effortless entertaining.The main living level includes a living room with a fireplace and bay window, a dining area, and a remodeled chef's kitchen equipped with a Sub-Zero refrigerator, Wolf stainless steel appliances, and a tile backsplash. Truly the soul of the home, the kitchen connects naturally with the surrounding living and dining spaces, creating an ideal setting for gathering and entertaining. Sliding glass doors open to an ocean-view deck with a dining bar and BBQ area.The lower level offers two bedrooms, each with an en-suite bathroom and direct access to a private outdoor patio. A third bedroom, currently used as an office or media room, is located on the entry level with an adjacent full bathroom and its own ocean view.Additional features include a wine cellar and a main-level two-car garage enhanced with newly installed epoxy flooring, offering both functionality and a polished finish. Community amenities include a heated pool and spa, clubhouse, tennis court, and a private staircase providing direct access to Westward Beach.The Point Dume location offers close proximity to beaches, coastal trails, schools, and the shops and restaurants of Point Dume Village.

results.remarks: Own a remarkable piece of Malibu history. Tucked behind handcrafted stone walls and wooden gates at the end of a picturesque country road in central Malibu, just 15 minutes from Pacific Coast Highway, this extraordinary single-level ranch estate offers an unforgettable combination of privacy, history, breathtaking ocean views, and endless possibilities. Originally part of the historic Baller family cattle ranch, this agriculturally zoned property is ideal for horses, livestock, vineyards, orchards, or hobby farming, offering a rare opportunity to embrace the ranch lifestyle while enjoying one of Malibu's most spectacular settings. The warm and inviting main residence is filled with timeless character, featuring vaulted plank wood ceilings, rich hardwood floors, custom built-ins, and a stunning stone fireplace that anchors the spacious living areas. Double doors from the dining room open to a screened-in porch where panoramic 180-degree ocean views stretch from the Queen's Necklace and Catalina Island up the coastline toward Santa Barbara, creating the perfect backdrop for morning coffee, sunset entertaining, or peaceful evenings surrounded by nature. The main home offers two comfortable bedrooms, while three detached bungalows provide exceptional flexibility for guests, extended family, creative studios, home offices, or income-producing rentals. Each bungalow enjoys its own private entrance, dedicated parking, heating and air conditioning, bedroom, and full bathroom. One bungalow also features a separate living room and charming kitchenette, making it especially well suited as a guest house or rental opportunity. The expansive grounds have been thoughtfully enhanced with new fencing and grading, creating multiple usable flat pads ready for your vision. Imagine a pool and spa, pickleball or sport court, outdoor kitchen, gym, cold plunge, gardens, or additional entertaining areas. The possibilities are virtually limitless. Completing the ranch lifestyle are a detached garage, ample guest parking, a charming chicken coop, future vegetable gardens, mature fruit trees, and majestic century-old Italian stone pines that provide beauty, shade, and remarkable privacy. Miles of nearby hiking trails wind through breathtaking canyons with ocean vistas and peaceful creek beds just beyond your backyard. Offering sweeping ocean views, usable acreage, incredible versatility, and an authentic connection to Malibu's rich ranching heritage, this is far more than a home it's a private sanctuary where history, nature, and opportunity come together. Properties with this level of character, land, privacy, and potential rarely become available.

results.remarks:
Tucked away in the storied beauty of Latigo Canyon, this private retreat unfolds like a scene from another era—where Old World romance meets the soul of classic rock. A home that feels discovered, not built… where every stone, archway, and terrace tells a story.

Inspired by the warmth and texture of a Tuscan villa, the residence is immersed in nature, surrounded by canyon walls, mature greenery, and the quiet rhythm of Malibu’s most serene landscape. Sunlight pours through open spaces and spills onto expansive patios, inviting an effortless indoor-outdoor lifestyle. Terraced grounds cascade gently down the hillside, creating intimate settings for morning espresso, late afternoon wine, or evenings under the stars.

There’s a mood here—subtle, but unmistakable. A sense of escape. Of creativity. Of timelessness. You can almost hear it… the faint echo of Led Zeppelin drifting through the halls, giving the home an edge of character that sets it apart from anything else in Malibu. It’s romantic, but not delicate—grounded, soulful, and deeply authentic.

Designed for those who appreciate privacy, beauty, and a connection to their surroundings, this property offers a rare blend of seclusion and inspiration. Whether as a full-time residence or a canyon getaway, it lives like a permanent vacation—where every day feels just a little more elevated, a little more intentional.

This is not just a home.
It’s a feeling.

results.remarks: Believed to be  Malibu's oldest standing residence, this extraordinary 1922 stone cabin offers a rare connection to the earliest days of the Malibu canyons. Originally built as a hunting retreat, the property dates to an era when travelers rode horseback from Los Angeles into the wilds of Malibu, staying here amid abundant wildlife and the life-giving waters of a year-round creek. Perched above the flowing creek and surrounded by the timeless beauty of the canyon, the home feels inseparable from its natural settingan enduring sanctuary shaped by stone, water, and more than a century of history. More than a residence, this is a living piece of Malibu's past and an exceptionally rare opportunity to preserve and inhabit its story. The property is over an acre with its own hiking trail leading up to a sitting area with ocean views through the mountains. Also on the property are two guests house both with living rooms, bathrooms and bedrooms allowing you to keep the charm of the cabin while allowing you space for guests on the property.

results.remarks: Nestled on a rare private flat lot along Sicomoro Drive in the prestigious gated community of Malibu West, this beautifully renovated residence offers an unparalleled sense of seclusion and tranquility. Tucked against the majestic Santa Monica Mountains, the home enjoys a peaceful, sanctuary-like setting while remaining in one of Malibu's most sought-after neighborhoods. Bathed in natural light, the interiors showcase timeless sophistication through expansive windows and glass doors that seamlessly frame the surrounding canyon landscape. Wide-plank oak flooring, warm wood accents, vaulted ceilings with exposed beams, and a thoughtfully curated palette of natural materials create an atmosphere of refined comfort. The open-concept living spaces flow effortlessly between the grand living room, anchored by a dramatic marble fireplace; the gourmet kitchen featuring sleek quartz countertops, custom white cabinetry, and a striking black range; and versatile dining areas ideal for intimate gatherings or larger celebrations. A separate lounge provides an intimate retreat, perfect for relaxed evenings. The primary suite serves as a true sanctuary, complete with its own fireplace, private balcony overlooking the treetops, and a luxurious spa-inspired bathroom featuring a new steam shower, soaking tub, walk-in shower, and elegant designer finishes. Additional spacious bedrooms offer abundant natural light and serene views of the lush gardens and canyon beyond. Outdoors, the generous grounds- nearly half an acre- extend the living experience with a sprawling lawn, meticulously landscaped gardens, and multiple patios ideal for al fresco dining and entertaining beneath the canopy of mature trees. This exceptional combination of usable outdoor space and natural privacy is seldom found in such a central Malibu location.  Malibu West residents enjoy exclusive amenities, including private beach access via the community's private beach club, pickleball and tennis courts, and the security of 24-hour guard-gated entry. This distinguished home on Sicomoro Drive perfectly embodies the effortless elegance and relaxed sophistication that define Malibu living.

The resort-style backyard is thoughtfully landscaped and features a large pool, a dining area, built-in kitchen/BBQ, and a fire pit. results.remarks: A soulful Corral Canyon retreat with sweeping mountain views, flexible living spaces, and a separate-entry guest suite just minutes from PCH. Set among mature oaks and canyon greenery, this four-bedroom Malibu home offers volume, light, privacy, and an indoor-outdoor rhythm that captures the relaxed beauty of canyon living with easy access to Malibu's coastline. Nestled on a generous lot amidst nature, this property is the perfect reflection of the quiet serenity and tight-knit charm that defines this special Malibu neighborhood. The home welcomes you through a charming garden entry courtyard. The interior features soaring ceilings and architectural elements such as wood beams, large windows and reclaimed wood flooring throughout. This four-bedroom residence offers a comfortable layout with spaces that flow naturally towards the outdoors. The primary suite, along with the open living room, dining room, half-bath, spacious chef's kitchen and large porch, are on the main level, while the downstairs consists of an open family room flanked by two additional bedrooms. The fourth bedroom has a separate entrance and functions as an attached guest suite complete with it's own kitchen, laundry, outdoor shower, hot tub, and a tranquil sitting area. Ideally positioned just eight minutes from PCH, the home places you at the doorstep of everything that makes Malibu one of the most coveted communities in the world. Malibu's brand new, highly regarded schools are close by, while some of the coast's most spectacular hiking trails wind through the surrounding Santa Monica Mountains with sweeping ocean panoramas at nearly every turn. World-famous beaches, beloved local dining, and the laid-back energy of Malibu's coastline are all just a short drive down the canyon. Outdoor living is woven throughout the property with multiple decks and screened living spaces that frame the canyon scenery from every angle, perfect for morning coffee as the light fills the valley, sunset dinners as the sky shifts to gold, or simply sitting in stillness surrounded by birdsong and oak-scented air. This is a home where nature is not a backdrop, but a daily companion, and where the seamless connection between indoors and out is felt in every moment.

results.remarks: Newly updated ocean-view townhome with coveted Riviera III beach rights to Little Dume, the most private and idyllic sandy beach in all of Malibu! Situated in the outermost row of a gated complex, this rare property offers a gateway to the quintessential coastal lifestyle with sweeping mountain and ocean views. Inside, the home is flooded with natural light by an abundance of large skylights and offers a casual layout with exceptionally large square footage. The living room features high beamed ceilings, oversized windows with mountain views, and an Italian fireplace. The kitchen flows to a dining area and out onto a private sun-drenched patio, with endless views from Zuma to Buzzards Roost and beyond. Upstairs, the primary suite offers soaring ceilings with a private balcony, en-suite bathroom, and updated walk-in closet. The second bedroom features peaceful views and there is an additional full bathroom, entry level powder room, and a large loft that could be used as an office, media room, or converted to a third bedroom. An attached two-car garage offers ample storage and a washer/dryer. Point Dume is one of Malibu's most iconic locations, and this townhome is ideally situated next to the shops and restaurants at Point Dume Village. Take your golf cart to Little Dume and enjoy the finest beach that Malibu has to offer, with sandy coves making it a private paradise.

results.remarks:
High above the Pacific, where five acres of golden hillside meet the horizon, sits a home built not from a plan book, but from vision. This custom retreat was designed with intention, blending thoughtful craftsmanship, exceptional functionality, and sweeping ocean views into a truly special setting.
Every bedroom is located on the main level, with the exception of the primary suite, which sits apart as a quiet world of its own. Here, the ocean views greet you first thing each morning, without a single stair standing between you and the beauty beyond.
At the heart of the home, a gourmet kitchen invites you to slow down and gather. A broad island is made for rolling dough and gathering around, complemented by a dedicated vegetable sink, a six-burner Wolf range that means business, and a deep storage pantry. Custom concrete floors ground the space, while rich Douglas fir ceilings rise overhead, creating a warm, natural atmosphere reminiscent of a forest cathedral.
The fourth bedroom has been thoughtfully transformed into a dedicated exercise room, offering plenty of space for a complete home gym. A Pilates reformer, rowing machine, yoga mats, weights, and other equipment can all be comfortably accommodated.
Out back, the patio becomes the heart of outdoor living, designed for long evenings, good company, and pizzas pulled piping hot from your own freestanding oven as the sun sets over the Pacific. It is a setting made for lingering.
Beneath it all, practical independence meets effortless beauty with a private well, solar power, and backup generators. And tucked at the base of the hillside is a manufactured home, currently tenant-occupied, offering the rare opportunity for built-in rental income, a private guest retreat, or additional flexibility for the property.
Five acres. One view you will never tire of. A home built to last, and a lifestyle built to match.

results.remarks: Coastal chic meets effortless Malibu living in this beautifully remodeled end-unit townhome, privately situated within the gated Vista Pacifica community above Broad Beach. Breathtaking ocean views, soaring vaulted ceilings, and a bright, open-concept floor plan create a relaxed yet refined atmosphere throughout. Large-format, concrete-inspired LVT flooring adds a sleek, contemporary touch to the interiors. The stunningly appointed kitchen features white quartz countertops, a Wolf oven, speed oven, induction cooktop, and range hood, along with a Bosch refrigerator and dishwasher. Lutron motorized window shades and solar film on all downstairs windows enhance comfort and privacy. The thoughtfully designed two-bedroom layout offers dual primary suites, each serving as a private retreat. The main primary suite opens to a private ocean-view deck, while the expansive wraparound deck downstairs flows into a generous grassy area, creating one of the community's largest and most versatile outdoor spaces for entertaining, dining al fresco, or relaxing in the coastal breeze. Additional upgrades include a nearly new HVAC system, water heater, an LG WashTower, a HALO 5 water filtration system, and a Tesla Level 2 charger in the garage. Residents enjoy a community pool, spa, and fitness center, all just minutes from Vintage Groceries, local restaurants, Broad Beach, scenic trails, and the best of Malibu's coastal lifestyle.

results.remarks: Tucked into the serene hills of Malibu, this privately gated nearly 6-acre sanctuary offers a rare blend of privacy, natural beauty, and effortless living, all within easy reach of the coastline. The turn-key 2-bedroom, 2-bath single-story home features open, airy spaces, seamless indoor-outdoor flow, and a large bonus room ideal for a studio, office, or guest space.Surrounded by rolling hills and unspoiled landscape, the property captures sweeping pastoral views from misty mornings to golden sunsets, inviting a slower, more intentional pace of life. The grounds include a mature orchard and a tranquil creek bordering the property, enhancing the peaceful setting. An exceptional equestrian property, it features a 4-stall breezeway barn with turnouts, a spacious corral and riding arena, and ample land for horses to roam and graze.Thoughtful upgrades include a pergola, expanded power to the barn, rain gutters, a 2,500-gallon rainwater catchment system with additional tanks near the creek, an upgraded well with an 8,000-gallon storage tank, Starlink internet, and improved septic access.Enjoy direct access to over 40 miles of the Backbone Trail, with scenic riding and hiking routes leading to ocean-view paths and Boney Peak in the Santa Monica Mountains. A peaceful retreat with modern functionality, this property offers a truly connected and elevated Malibu lifestyle.

results.remarks: Beachfront living meets resort-style amenities in this gated, bright 2-bedroom, 2-bath condominium set in the sought-after Tivoli Cove community of Latigo Bay. Enjoy views of the Pacific Ocean from the main living space and primary bedroom, where oversized sliding doors with Phantom screens create an easy indoor-outdoor flow to a generous ocean facing patio that stretches across the residence. A fireplace anchors the living room, offering a comfortable gathering space ideal for entertaining or relaxing. The updated kitchen has been refreshed with stainless appliances, marble counters, ample cabinetry, and flows into the open dining area. The layout is also thoughtfully designed with privacy in mind, positioning two separate bedroom suites on opposite sides of the home. The primary suite features a remodeled bath, custom closet system with built-ins, and Teza accordion doors. The secondary bedroom is spacious and includes ample storage plus an additional bath with a shower/tub combo, ideal for guests, roommates, or everyday living. Behind the gates, Tivoli Cove offers direct access to a private beach with an awesome surf break, along with two tennis courts, a volleyball court, pool, spa, fitness center, sauna, clubhouse, picnic/grilling area, laundry facilities, and guest parking. Located moments from pristine sandy beaches, the historic Getty Villa, and the vibrant dining and shopping of both Malibu and Santa Monica, this property offers a rare combination of peaceful privacy and coastal convenience. HOA fee includes water, trash, sewer and building insurance.

Known for its cove beaches and natural beauty, this property is an ocean lover's paradise, mere steps from the sand. The main level offers one bedroom and one bathroom, kitchen, dining and living area. Private laundry, A/C, beautiful tile floors with a hardwood look, new fixtures, finishes, electrical and plumbing throughout. 1 car carport plus 1 additional uncovered parking spaces. Don't miss this opportunity to own this renovated unit where you can bring your toothbrush and start enjoying just in time for summer. The furniture can also be purchased separately as well. The Malibu Bay Club is one of only a few beachfront complexes in Malibu. Gated with secured entry, beautiful pool area with spa and direct beach access to sandy coves. The community recently completed renovations to all the condo exteriors including new roofs, copper gutters, new exterior paint, tile and more. Currently the pool area is undergoing a renovation and is due to be completed late summer 2026.

results.remarks: Cradled directly on the sand along one of Malibu's most coveted beachfront stretches, this rare oceanfront parcel offers the ultimate canvas for those who dream of living with the ocean at their doorstep: sunrises over the water, the sound of waves, and effortless access to Santa Monica and greater Los Angeles. The 2,834-square-foot lot previously housed a 2,957-square-foot residence within this intimate and highly prized coastal enclave. Today, it presents a compelling opportunity to rebuild directly on the water with meaningful entitlement advantages. Under current emergency provisions, CEQA and Coastal Commission review may be avoided, provided the new home is constructed substantially in the same location and within 110% of the prior structure's footprint and height. results.remarks: Where the Ocean Meets your Morning Coffee:  Some homes ask you to compromise. This one refuses to let you.  Perched in an intimate, whisper-quiet 16-unit building, this stunning corner unit delivers what most people only pin to their vision boards  panoramic ocean views that stretch from sunrise to sunset, without a neighbor in sight on one side.  Privacy isn't an amenity here. It's a lifestyle.  Step inside and you'll find a complete head-to-toe renovation done with intention: rich new hardwood floors flow through the living spaces, recessed lighting sets the perfect mood at every hour, and a sleek kitchen outfitted with new stainless steel appliances makes cooking feel less like a chore and more like a pleasure  especially with that view as your backdrop.  The primary bedroom is a genuine retreat, waking you each morning with the Pacific stretched across your window in full technicolor. New plush carpet in both bedrooms keeps things cozy underfoot, because not every moment needs to be dramatic,   though the views will make sure most of them are.  The second bedroom is a rare gem: with the option of its own separate private entrance, it functions beautifully as a guest suite, home office, creative studio, or income-generating opportunity. You decide.  A few more things worth loving:  Minimal stairs  easy in, easy out, On-site laundry, the unglamorous stuff, handled,  Fresh paint throughout, move-in ready, wired for security system.   Sleep soundly (the ocean sounds will help too) And the location? Ten minutes to Santa Monica. Ten minutes to central Malibu. You're not choosing between the energy of the city and the soul of the coast  you're living exactly between both.  Units like this in buildings this small and this quiet don't come around often. When they do, they don't stay long.  The ocean's been waiting. Come see it from where it looks best.

results.remarks: Located in the heart of Central Malibu, this desirable single-level 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom condo offers the ideal blend of comfort, convenience, and coastal living. Situated within the gated Malibu Canyon Village community, this move-in ready residence features a thoughtfully designed open floor plan with two spacious en-suite bedroomsperfect for privacy, cohabitation, or rental flexibility.The bright and airy living room flows seamlessly into the dining area and opens to a private patio/balcony showcasing breathtaking ocean, mountain, and lush marshland views. Tucked away from Pacific Coast Highway, the unit offers a peaceful setting while remaining close to everything Malibu has to offer.Community amenities include a  pool with panoramic ocean and mountain views, tennis court, and fitness center. The property also includes two covered, assigned parking spaces, additional storage, and  guard-gated security for added peace of mind.Ideally located just minutes from Pepperdine University, Webster Elementary, Our Lady of Malibu School, Malibu Farmers Market, beaches, hiking trails, and Malibu's premier dining and shopping destinations. Convenient access to Calabasas, Agoura Hills, Westlake Village, and Thousand Oaks, including a short drive to Erewhon Market.This property is well-suited as a primary residence, weekend retreat, or investment opportunity.

results.remarks: Perched atop its own private Malibu mountaintop, this gated estate commands what is arguably one of the most extraordinary views along the Southern California coasta vast, unobstructed panorama stretching from Palos Verdes and Catalina Island to the sun setting beyond Point Dume, while the dramatic peaks and ancient rock formations of Saddle Peak rise behind the property. A long private driveway climbs above the world below, passing a secluded two-bedroom guesthouse near the entrance before arriving at the approximately 5,500 sq ft main residence. One of Malibu's rare homes to rise three full stories from ground level, the residence was conceived around a dramatic central staircase that creates a striking architectural centerpiece and connects its expansive living spaces. Below, a fourth underground basement level offers an additional realm of possibilities for a  wine cellar or private entertaining space. The property is also being run by solar panels and well water allowing you the potential to live completely off grid. Surrounded by ocean, mountains, and changing coastal light, Valle Lindo is more than a home, it is a private sanctuary suspended above Malibu, where sunrise illuminates the mountains and each evening ends with the sun disappearing into the Pacific.

results.remarks: Perched on 3.45 acres above Western Malibu, this exceptional custom estate offers sweeping panoramic views of Point Mugu State Park, Boney Ridge, and sparkling city lights. Extensively remodeled in 2004, with approximately 60% new construction at that time, the home showcases remarkable craftsmanship with globally sourced finishes, including hand-carved Nepalese doors, custom wrought iron, and imported Mexican stone. A grand entry with a fountain opens to the main level, featuring a spacious family room with marble fireplace, wet bar with Talavera sink, four of the five bedrooms, three bathrooms, and a dry sauna. Upstairs, the great room impresses with soaring 18-foot wood-beamed ceilings, a fireplace, and a loft ideal for an office or retreat. The chef's kitchen offers custom cabinetry, granite countertops, a butler's pantry, and a scenic breakfast nook. The primary suite includes a sitting area, fireplace, spa-like bath, and custom closets. Outdoor patios capture breathtaking canyon and city views. Additional features include a three-car garage and ample additional parking. Located approximately 20 minutes from Central Malibu, Camarillo, and Oxnard, this private retreat offers a rare combination of tranquility, privacy, and accessibility.

results.remarks: New Co-Ownership Opportunity: Own one-eighth of this turnkey home, professionally managed by Pacaso. Escondido sits behind two private gates on Pacific Coast Highway, a palm-lined two-acre property with mature olive and fruit trees that gives the estate a rare sense of privacy on this stretch of coast. The white stucco exterior has a Mediterranean character  arched windows, terrace levels and a presence that reads as unhurried and substantial against the hillside.The entry foyer opens to a grand double staircase beneath 30-foot ceilings, with light hardwood and parquet floors running throughout the main level. The all-white kitchen has beamed ceilings, Caesarstone countertops, a large island with open shelving and a casual dining area alongside. A formal dining room, office, library and gym give Escondido a range of spaces that suits longer stays and larger groups equally well. The primary bedroom is on the second floor with ocean views, a fireplace and an en suite bath with a freestanding soaking tub and walk-in shower. The theater, bar, wine cellar and game room sit on the lower level alongside the remaining bedrooms.The pool and spa sit on a terrace with ocean views, and the grounds include walking paths, a volleyball court and multiple outdoor dining and lounge areas. The separate guest house has its own kitchen, living area and sunny deck. Escondido Beach is minutes away, and Geoffrey's Malibu, with its clifftop California-Mediterranean cooking and sweeping ocean views, is close for dinner.Escondido is professionally designed, appointed and managed by Pacaso. Every detail is handled and every arrival is ready, so owners simply show up and the estate does the rest.
